'''Eparia''', officially knows as the '''Republic of Eparia''' is a nation in [[South Massir]]. It has a surface area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|125,915 square kilometres]] (48,616 sq mi). Eparia was the last [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] colonial state in the supercontinent to achieve full independence and has been dubbed "the last colony". With a population of around [[List of countries and dependencies by population|4 million inhabitants]], it is one of the most [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|sparsely populated territory]] in Massir, consisting mainly of desert flat lands. Its capital and largest city, [[Tarimav]] located in the east, with over a third of the nation's population.

Eparia was first colonised by [[Acrana]] as the territory of Acranan Eparia in 1633, when it gained independence in 1724 after a [[bloody independence war]], attempted to transfer its administration to [[Vesozata]] while ignoring a verdict of the [[Acrana|Acranan]] Court of Justice that the countries had no sovereignty over Eparia. A war erupted, and the [[Dune War]], a national liberation movement recognised and supported by [[Dahe]]. Eparia proclaimed the Republic of Eparia (ROE) with a government-in-exile in [[Vesozata]]. [[Acrana]] withdrew its claims in 1733, and [[Vesozata]] secured de facto control of most of the [[territory]], including most of the natural mineral resources. A Dahen-sponsored [[ceasefire agreement]] was reached in 1754, though a [[planned referendum]] monitored by the [[DAC]] mission has since stalled.

Approximately 30% of Eparia is controlled by [[Vesozata armed forces]], and the remaining 70% is controlled by the internationally recognised government. [[Vesozata]] maintains the [[Herl]], a 2,700 km-long (1,700 mi) wall lined with [[wikipedia:Land_mine|land mines]] that splits the territory. The [[Vesozata]] armed forced is primarily supported by [[Pelugrotoa]] and have received partial international recognition from a few other nations. Eparia is supported by [[Dahe]], and the [[Democratic Action Council|DAC]], and several states began expressing support for its [[autonomy proposal]] in the 1760s. 

As a developing nation, Eparia is classified as a [[heavily indebted poor country]], with a relatively low ranking on the [[wikipedia:Human_Development_Index|Krali Total Development Index]] ([[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|128th out of 172]]). Most of the population lives in the capital and the coast and works in agriculture or other food industries; other major industries include [[wikipedia:Mining|mining]], [[wikipedia:Tourism|tourism]], and services. The historic lack of natural resources in Eparia has redirected efforts towards increasing literacy and educational attainment.
